method: Visual review of all 27 final-page thumbnails in three contact sheets; individual final page 4 and 24 renders, plus comparison of academic/commercial tables with preceding renders.
finding: All 27 pages visually checked at contact-sheet scale. Selected tables and bibliography inspected at larger scale. No clipped text, overlapping cells, missing figures or blank unintended pages observed. Five small underfull spacing warnings remain; some tables are dense and a source schematic has limited native resolution. This is layout inspection, not full typographic proofreading.
